info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Reopens-v2-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of support tickets that have been reopened for assistance. It allows users to access detailed information about tickets, including their status and history of interactions. This functionality is essential for support teams and analysts who need to track customer issues effectively. Typical consumers include support staff and project managers focusing on issue resolution and customer satisfaction. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their ticket management processes and enhance customer service.

get.description: This operation allows users to reopen a ticket that was previously closed, bringing it back into the open status for further action or review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the criteria for reopening a ticket. It must contain the necessary information required by the service to process the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the ticket has been reopened.

ListSupportTicketsReopensRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for reopening a ticket through the GET operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.title: Ticket Reopen Response

status.description: Indicates if the request to reopen the ticket was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reopened ticket.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the reopen operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after reopening.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the reopen request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing more details about the reopen request.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the reopen operation.

ListSupportTicketsReopensResponse_200.description: Response schema for the operation that reopens a ticket.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit information related to the ticket operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
